segments.name: Transaction revenue
segments.note: Fees from crypto trading — consumer $450M, institutional $92M, other $48M. When trading volumes fall, this falls fastest.

segments.name: Subscription and services revenue
segments.note: Steadier income: stablecoin revenue $307M, blockchain rewards $86M, interest and finance fees $69M, and other services $109M.

segments.name: Other revenue
segments.note: Interest earned on Coinbase's own corporate cash — smaller as balances and rates fell.

opex.name: Technology & development
opex.note: Building the platform. Shown net of $49M of operating gains Coinbase reports as negative expenses (gains on crypto held for operations, a restructuring credit and other operating income).

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company — legal, compliance and the back office; down 24% YoY as Coinbase cut costs.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Advertising and winning customers — trimmed 7% YoY in a quiet market.

oneTimers: A $715M mark-to-market gain on crypto assets held for investment accounts for essentially all of the quarter's $719M net income. Coinbase's operating business, by contrast, earned $62M.
verdict: Coinbase's revenue fell 35% to $1.22B as trading slowed and operating profit shrank to just $62M — yet it still reported $719M of net income, because the crypto it holds as an investment gained $715M in value.
otherDetail: A $715.0M gain on crypto assets Coinbase holds as an investment, plus $66.7M of other income, minus $19.5M of interest expense.
footerNote: Coinbase reports no gross-profit line; 'Transaction expense' — the direct cost of processing trades — is shown as cost of revenue. Figures are from Coinbase's Q3 2026 Form 10-Q, the detailed companion to its earnings release.

takeaways.title: Trading revenue took the hit
takeaways.text: Transaction revenue fell 44% to $590M in a quiet crypto market. Subscriptions and services held up better (−20%), and stablecoin revenue of $307M barely fell — the steadier business is becoming the bigger one.

takeaways.title: The profit is an investment gain
takeaways.text: Operating profit was just $62M. Net income of $719M exists because crypto Coinbase holds on its own balance sheet gained $715M — if crypto prices fall, that line reverses just as fast.

takeaways.title: Costs were cut to match the market
takeaways.text: Total operating expenses fell 17% YoY, and Adjusted EBITDA rose 60% from Q2 to $333M — Coinbase's 15th straight positive quarter, through boom and bust alike.

follow100Note: Kept-as-profit includes +$62.71 of other income per $100 of revenue; the rows add to $99.99 due to rounding.
